root_cause.text: Missing length validation for the dynamic array `matches` in `iwl_mvm_nd_match_info_handler`, allowing `memcpy` to read beyond the notification buffer when the packet is shorter than the base structure plus the expected matches length.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the validation from `len < sizeof(struct iwl_scan_offload_match_info)` to `len < sizeof(struct iwl_scan_offload_match_info) + matches_len`, explicitly adding the size of the dynamic array to prevent out-of-bounds read during the subsequent `memcpy`. The CVE description confirms that the `memcpy` assumes `notif->matches` is at least as large as the copied bytes.
